title: Array Methods Practice
question: Use array methods (map, filter, and reduce) to transform the given array of numbers.
description:
Practice using essential array methods in JavaScript. You'll need to:
1. Use map() to double each number
2. Use filter() to keep only even numbers
3. Use reduce() to calculate the sum

testCases.description: Should correctly transform array using map, filter, and reduce

title: Variables and Data Types
question: Create variables of different data types and display their types using typeof operator.
description: In this exercise, you'll learn about JavaScript's basic data types including string, number, boolean, undefined, and object.

testCases.expected:
String: string
Number: number
Boolean: boolean
Undefined: undefined
Object: object
testCases.description: Should correctly identify all data types

title: Functions and Parameters
question: Create a function that takes two parameters and returns their sum.
description: Learn how to create functions, pass parameters, and return values in JavaScript.

title: Arrays and Loops
question: Create an array of numbers and use a for loop to calculate their sum.
description: Practice working with arrays and for loops in JavaScript.
